story_theme_en: Chef Ai made 30 chocolate chip cookies at the bakery. She put them in boxes with 6 cookies in each box. Chef Ai wondered how many boxes she would need. Division helps us share things equally into groups.
helper_tip_en: Read the problem carefully. Circle the important numbers. Then figure out what the question is asking.
think_story_en: We have 5 rows and 6 in each row. Use 5 x 6 = 5 boxes.
explanation_steps_en: Look at the dividend (total) and divisor (size of each group).
Divide the total by the size of each group.
Write the quotient as your answer.

worked_examples_en.question_en: Chef filled 24 cupcakes into boxes of 4. How many boxes are there?

hints_en: Read the problem twice before answering.
